  Scenario: AC8 The contract documents and the fixtures keep the nine business rules (new, R-30251)
    Given the contract documents and the four fixtures of this story
    When they are reviewed against the business rules of section 8
    Then the database is "rwb_sandbox", the build database is "rwb_sandbox_next" and the rename is the only publication step (BR1)
    Then "public" is the ACE test double, "recovery" holds the 30 views and helper functions, each service has one "rwb_*" schema seeded only after its own baseline with seed 20261128, no service seeds another service's schema, and the case rows are seeded once in "rwb_case" and referred to by plain key (BR2)
    Then "rwb_sandbox_read" is the one read-only role, with SELECT on "recovery" and "rwb_source_data", nothing on "public" and no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE anywhere (BR3)
    Then the seed, the volumes, the shape count, the list-of-values source and the personal-data pattern rule can each be overridden as profile data (BR4)
    Then the lists of values are read through the reference-data contract of rwb-case and never from a constant or a copy (BR5)
    Then the sandbox holds synthetic data only, is DEV only, and its ACE-shaped tables are never deployed to SIT, UAT or PROD (BR6)
    Then a failed build keeps the previous sandbox in use and publishes no partial database (BR7)
    Then the stage is a release activity, is not a Temporal Schedule and is not in "job_catalog" (BR8)
    Then only this service's objects and the ACE schema appear as this story's, and no other service's schema, table or operation does (BR9)
